key.name: name
key.description: 'default' is the stock Android 16 look. 'renaissance' is Cyberpunk meets Italian Renaissance: gold leaf, lapis and parchment on OLED black, neon cyan edges, Michelangelus capitals where the font is installed. The shell and the Neo apps follow it live; the kiosk picks it up on its next start.

key.name: day-look
key.description: Used while the system style is light: 'marble' is Carrara white marble with verde Alpi, 'sea' is warm sand with sky blue. Only while name is 'renaissance'.

key.name: night-look
key.description: Used while the system style is dark (org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme prefer-dark): 'forest' is green-black marble with moss veins, 'plum' is the granite plum look. Only while name is 'renaissance'.

key.name: font-display
key.description: Families (comma separated, first one installed wins) for clocks, titles and dialog titles while the Renaissance look is on. The stock face is always appended, so a missing font never blanks text. Fonts are the owner's own, in ~/.local/share/fonts on the phone, and are never part of the repository.

key.name: font-body
key.description: Families for everything else while the Renaissance look is on; empty keeps the stock face.

key.name: font-mono
key.description: Families for data text (status bar clock, tabular numbers, HUD microtext) while the Renaissance look is on.

key.name: previous-wallpaper
key.description: The wallpaper that was in use when the Renaissance look took over its own; Neo Settings puts it back when the look is switched off.

key.name: previous-icon-pack
key.description: The icon pack in use when the Renaissance look took over its own.
